translations.translation: Avoid use on broken or wounded skin.
If redness, swelling, or itching occurs during use, stop use and consult a specialist.
Store in a cool place away from direct sunlight.
Keep out of reach of children.
This product is not a pharmaceutical and may not be used for the care of any disease.
Use as soon as possible after opening.
Exchanges and refunds are available within 7 days of delivery.
